1.consolidated_definition: Mamífero plantígrado de hasta 67 cm de longitud, cabeza alargada, hocico estrecho con nariz muy saliente y puntiaguda, orejas cortas y redondeadas y pelaje largo y tupido; sus uñas fuertes y encorvadas le sirven para trepar a los árboles. Procyonidae; Nasua nasua.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Mammal with plantigrade posture, reaching up to 67 cm in length, having a elongated head, narrow snout with a very prominent and pointed nose, short and rounded ears, and long and dense fur; its strong and curved claws serve for climbing trees. Procyonidae; Nasua nasua.
